question: What is the difference between 1-ply, 2-ply and 3-ply tissues?
answer: 1-ply is a single layer (economical, for high-traffic areas), 2-ply has two layers (softer, standard for offices and restaurants), and 3-ply has three layers (premium softness, ideal for hotels and upscale venues). Each product page lists the ply count.
